description: This PHP file defines an abstract test class for verifying implementations of the Psr\\Log\\LoggerInterface. It provides various test methods to ensure compliance with the LoggerInterface contract, including log level handling, context processing, and exception throwing for invalid levels.

classes.name: LoggerInterfaceTest
classes.description: Abstract base test class for ensuring implementations of Psr\Log\LoggerInterface behave correctly.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the LoggerInterface implementation to be tested.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the array of logged messages for verification.

methods.name: testImplements
methods.description: Checks that the logger instance implements the Psr\Log\LoggerInterface.

methods.name: testLogsAtAllLevels
methods.description: Tests logging at all standard log levels and verifies the logs are recorded as expected.

methods.name: provideLevelsAndMessages
methods.description: Provides data sets of log levels and messages for parameterized testing.

methods.name: testThrowsOnInvalidLevel
methods.description: Verifies that logging with an invalid level throws an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testContextReplacement
methods.description: Tests the message interpolations with context values.

methods.name: testObjectCastToString
methods.description: Ensures objects implementing __toString() are correctly cast when logged.

methods.name: testContextCanContainAnything
methods.description: Verifies that the context array can contain various data types including objects and resources.

methods.name: testContextExceptionKeyCanBeExceptionOrOtherValues
methods.description: Checks that the 'exception' key in context can hold different types of data without causing issues.
